## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `treasury-ofac-attribute-service` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `treasury-ofac-attribute-service` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `sdn-list`, `consolidated-sanctions-list`, `sanctions-screening`

**Validation artifacts:** `ofac-screening-response.json`, `ofac-screening-audit.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/treasury-ofac-attribute-service/treasury-ofac-attribute-service.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `IA-2`, `AU-2`, `AU-12`, `CA-9`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **IA-2** Identification and Authentication | Supporting | Sanctions-screening claims supplement entity identification at compliance decision points. |
| **AU-2** Event Logging | Primary | Every screening event is logged with the canonical disclosure-audit envelope, decision-point reference, list version. |
| **AU-12** Audit Record Generation | Supporting | Audit records carry the canonical provenance envelope per ADR-006. |
| **CA-9** Internal System Connections | Supporting | Sanctions-screening is the canonical attribute supplied at compliance / disbursement integration points across the substrate. |

## Notes from canon

OFAC is the federal authority of record for sanctions screening. Public list distribution; entitlement model still applies for audit-grade screening disclosures within compliance and disbursement contexts (e.g., Treasury Do Not Pay). Activation requires a per-adapter ADR modeled on ADR-035.
